dataset_axes.record_id: Unique paper-window/date/accession key; actual annotation dates do not create additional windows.
dataset_axes.view: A.0/A.1 subdivide Track A reference content; Track B uses its complete target reference.
dataset_axes.cohort: full and paired are population selections, not tracks. Aggregate track=all combines A and B.

prediction_relevance.scope: Original risk-screened diagnostic subset; not full-benchmark coverage. Actual input dates are retained and records may differ from the final paper selection.

evaluation.recall: mean(support_score / 4) within protein and view, followed by equal protein weighting
evaluation.miss: all reference claims in a protein/view have support_score < 2
